# Heath & City Technology

> Private document systems for small practices in Hampstead and North
> West London: barristers and King's Counsel, insurance and stock
> brokers, composers and music publishers, surgeons and consultants,
> and family offices and property principals.
> Client, patient and fund records are never uploaded to public AI tools;
> systems run on a machine in the client's office or in a private UK vault.
> Technology and administrative services only; no legal, medical,
> investment or insurance advice.

## Details

- Website: https://heathandcity.com/
- Base: Hampstead Garden Suburb, London NW11 (visits by appointment)
- Areas served: NW3, NW6, NW8, NW11, N6 and the City of London
- Telephone: 020 4520 9114
- Email: contactus@heathandcity.com

## Fixed fees

- Two-week trial on your own documents: GBP 750 to 1,500
- Full set-up in your office: GBP 3,000 to 10,000+ (three to six weeks)
- Ongoing local care: GBP 350 to 1,200 a month, cancel with notice
